notes: SessionSifu 3.5.25 adds disabled-by-default readiness for the provisional Wayland session-management protocol in portable Linux builds. Activation requires an explicit per-run flag, a Wayland session and successful bounded compositor-registry detection. Only cooperating applications may claim windows; claimed windows are never also moved by the legacy geometry backend. Unsupported states fail closed, and normal GNOME/KDE restoration is unchanged. See docs/RESTORE_GUIDE.md for scope and limitations.
